response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT t.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry GROUP BY t.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_count, AVG(sr.avg_rate - o.avg_rate) AS average_excess FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.avg_rate > o.avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: The average count is the average number of matched scans per qualifying status, including scans with a missing rate. A zero duration has no usable rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only scans with a usable file-size-per-minute rate in each status.
